note: The calls made by hand on 29-Aug-2026, when the May-2026 price list was reconciled against the Tally stock summary. Everything here overrides what the price list or the stock summary would otherwise say, and every entry records why - a bare number with no reason behind it is how the last catalogue drifted.
priceSourceWhy: Cost = Itwari SS price, selling = UltraClean Dist. price, both effective 01-05-2026. Tally's closing rate is a weighted average of what was paid across the year and had drifted more than 10% from the list on 53 of the matched items; taking both prices from one document is what makes every margin real. Items with no counterpart in the list keep their Tally rate as cost.

exclude.Deep Clean Mop 9'': Not to be carried any more.
exclude.Prime Dust Pan: Discontinued - to come out of the app.

Orrisa Broom Alladin.why: The list prints 688 / 792, which is a lost decimal point: every other broom is between 17 and 102, Tally's rate is 66.65 and invoice 994 bills it at 71.00. 82 is the revised selling price, not the 79.20 the list implies.

Premium Dust Pan.why: We stock Premium where the list has Wonder Dust Pan. Same cost, revised selling price.

UC Airfrshner 50gm.why: Priced per piece at the list's 18 / 21, and counted per piece. Tally's 51.13 is a pack-of-four rate, which is why it looks three times too high.

UC Steel Scrubber Red.why: Counted by the piece in Tally, priced by the pack on the list. Six to a pack, whatever the list's item name says.

UC Steel Scrubber 12pcs Yellow.why: Tally counts this loose, by the piece; the list prices it by the pack of twelve. The quantity is converted to packs so the two agree.

Steel Scrubber Green.why: Counted by the piece in Tally, priced by the pack of twelve on the list.

UC Comfort Patla.why: Counted by the piece in Tally, priced by the pack of four on the list.
